messages:
maya: Noticed several customer dashboards showing unrendered tiles after the analytics spike ~15:20 UTC. Spinners forever then a 502 overlay on some panels. :frowning:
keith: :eyes: Which orgs? any common panel type (timeseries, heatmap)?
maya: Mostly time-series panels with a group_by on user_id. High cardinality queries. Happens across regions, eg eu-west.
sophie: I can replicate on prod using the exact query from the support ticket — stays loading then errors. Attached logs show: 
```
GET /api/v1/query?panel_id=8423&from=1670000000&to=1670003600  -> upstream error: read tcp ... i/o timeout (upstream 10.12.5.3:9000)
```
keith: Sounds like analytics API timed out on the slow path. Any recent deploys to analytics or aggregator in the last hour? ops-bot: deploy-bot reports: deploy analytics-aggregator v2.7.1 at 2215011200 (canary -> 60%).
randall: We rolled a kernel tweak to streaming fanout yesterday that might affect long group_by scans.
maya: Support ticket shows user saw a transient 502, then panels permanently show blank even after retrying browser refresh.
sophie: Repro steps I used: 1) open dashboard 2) set range 1h 3) click refresh. Curl to internal analytics API returns 504 after ~30s: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://analytics.internal/api/query" -d '{"panel_id":8423,"from":1670000000,"to":1670003600}' -v
```
keith: Two immediate asks: (1) capture analytics svc logs for that trace_id (if present) and (2) try query with limit on cardinality (eg remove user_id group_by) to confirm high-cardinality is culprit.
randall: I pulled logs for the window: saw long tail compaction + a spike of heap GC around the same time. Also saw repeated "kv-cache miss" for prefix cache entries.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-314 - Dashboard tiles unrendered on high-card queries. Priority: P2
maya: Workaround we suggested to customer: reduce time window or remove user_id grouping. They can also switch to "sampled" mode on the panel.
sophie: Quick mitigation: rolling rollback of analytics-aggregator v2.7.1 to v2.7.0 on canary to see if errors reduce. keith, can you coordinate?
keith: On it. Rolling back canary now. Will watch error rate and dashboard render success.
keith: Rollback complete at 2215012500. Metrics: analytics API 5xx rate dropped from 9.2% -> 1.1% over 5m.
maya: Customer confirmed dashboards started rendering again after ~3m. They reported data was delayed but visible. :relieved:
randall: Root cause hypothesis: v2.7.1 introduced a change that increased memory pressure for group_by streams causing GC pauses and triggering slow-path timeouts. Also exposed a cache key encoding bug causing repeated prefix misses.
sophie: Action items: (1) create a regression ticket for aggregator change that touches streaming/group_by (2) add a circuit-breaker for high-cardinality queries to fail fast (3) add better telemetry on prefix cache hit/miss by panel_id.
maya: Noting for support: advise customers to reduce cardinality, use sampling, or increase panel timeout (short-term). Updating the ticket reply.
ops-bot: INC-2026-314 updated: status -> mitigated, owner -> keith, next steps added.
keith: I'll follow up with a postmortem draft tomorrow. Leaving this thread open until we have a fix PR ready. :thumbsup:
